{{Attr|Bloated}} (Wave 37 only) |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Haunted Summon}}''' - '''Reaper''' slams its scythe, creating a pentagram that summons three [[Demon]]s. |ability2 = '''{{WikiAb|Soul Reap}}''' - '''Reaper''' slashes its scythe at a tower, stunning it. }} ==Description== The '''Reaper''' is a summoner enemy that appears in [[Pizza Party]]. It has a high amount of health and below average speed. It also has two immunities, [[Stun Immunity]] and [[Burn Immunity]]. It has two abilities, the first being ''Haunted Summon'', which makes it summon three [[Demon]]s, which then spawn [[Sin]]s upon death. The second ability is ''Soul Reap'', which makes it attack a tower in its range, stunning it. ==Appearance== The '''Reaper''' is a large humanoid with a waist in its rig. It has a black skin tone, a dark grey ragged cloak with sleeves, pants and a hood with a dark red trim, light grey legs, and a dark red cape. It has a grey chain draped across its torso and has black spikes coming out of its shoulders. It wields a white scythe with a skull on top, which has grey horns and a black blade on it. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers like the [[Ranger]], [[Engineer]], [[Turret]] or [[Accelerator]] are recommended against this. **Do note that on Wave 39, the '''Reaper''' spawns as a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy. High DPS towers with hidden detection are needed against this. ***The [[Firework Technician]], [[Ace Pilot]] and [[UAV]] can be used to give your towers hidden detection. **The [[DJ Booth]] and [[Commander]] can also be quite useful at boosting their statistics. *Its ''Haunted Summon'' ability summons three [[Demon]]s, which then summons even more [[Sin]]s, creating huge crowds of enemies. **Area of effect towers, like the [[Mortar]], [[Electroshocker]] or [[Pursuit]] can be used to clear out both the crowds of enemies and the '''Reaper''' itself. *The [[Medic]] can be used to shield towers, preventing them from being stunned by the '''Reaper'''. *Placing down cheap distraction towers near the '''Reaper''' can be quite useful, as it will prevent the '''Reaper''' from stunning more important towers. **Additionally, in cases where it would normally be unable to hit any tower, it prevents it from being guaranteed to use its ''Haunted Summon'' ability, making it far easier to deal with. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} ReaperWalk.gif|Walking animation (22 January 2025 – Present) ReaperSummon.gif|''Haunted Summon'' animation (22 January 2025 – Present) ReaperAttack.gif|''Soul Reap'' animation (22 January 2025 – Present) ReaperDeath.gif|Death animation (22 January 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseReaper.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V2.5.0GenericThumbnail5.png|'''Reaper''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ReaperIconIG.png|'''Reaper''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Update History== *'''22 January 2025''' -
